description: This file contains JavaScript code for a workflow viewer component, including classes and functions to initialize and manage workflow diagrams using jsPlumb, with dependencies on external modules and libraries.

classes.name: class
classes.description: Main class for managing the workflow diagram, creating jsPlumb instances, and handling connections and layout.

methods.name: workflowViewer
methods.description: Initializes the workflow viewer on selected DOM elements.

methods.name: getActivityElements
methods.description: Retrieves activity elements within the container.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Provides default configuration for jsPlumb instances.

methods.name: createJsPlumbInstance
methods.description: Creates and configures a new jsPlumb instance.

methods.name: getEndpointColor
methods.description: Determines endpoint color based on activity properties.

methods.name: getSourceEndpointOptions
methods.description: Returns configuration for source endpoints based on activity and outcome.

methods.name: updateConnections
methods.description: Updates diagram connections based on workflow transitions.

methods.name: updateCanvasHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the height of the canvas based on activity positions.
